tactical_replacement_rationale: If Pathirana is retained by KKR, Nathan Ellis is the immediate like-for-like overseas yorker specialist. If an overseas slot must be conserved for batting, Mohsin Khan is the premier left-arm domestic replacement.

If Tim David is retained by RCB, Naman Dhir delivers equivalent high-leverage finishing ceiling (68.69) without costing an overseas player slot. Glenn Maxwell provides uncontracted power hitting if registered.
If Narine is retained as expected by KKR, Varun Chakravarthy is the direct domestic mystery spin alternative offering sub-7.2 middle overs economy against both left- and right-handed batters.
If Khaleel Ahmed is retained by CSK, Mohsin Khan represents the next-highest Indian left-arm pacer in the pool, offering multi-phase flexibility.
If Klaasen and Pooran are retained by SRH and LSG, Prabhsimran Singh or free-agent Jonny Bairstow provide immediate tactical depth at a significantly lower purse commitment.
